label: Statuspage
description: Manage incidents, components, subscribers and scheduled maintenance

operations.name: list_pages
operations.description: List the pages accessible to this API key; also proves the connected account.

operations.name: list_incidents
operations.description: Read one page of incidents, optionally searching their name, status and updates.

operations.name: get_incident
operations.description: Read an incident or maintenance, including its update history.

operations.name: create_incident
operations.description: Create an incident; for scheduled maintenance set status=scheduled and supply both timestamps.

operations.name: update_incident
operations.description: Publish an update, resolve an incident, or transition a maintenance. Omitted fields are unchanged.

operations.name: delete_incident
operations.description: Permanently delete an incident or scheduled maintenance.

operations.name: list_unresolved_incidents
operations.description: Read unresolved incidents for a page.

operations.name: list_scheduled_maintenance
operations.description: Read one page of scheduled incidents.

operations.name: list_upcoming_maintenance
operations.description: Read one page of upcoming maintenance.

operations.name: list_active_maintenance
operations.description: Read one page of maintenance currently in progress.

operations.name: list_components
operations.description: Read one page of components and their statuses (at most 100).

operations.name: get_component
operations.description: Read a component and its status.

operations.name: create_component
operations.description: Create a component on the page.

operations.name: update_component
operations.description: Change a component's status, name, description or group.

operations.name: delete_component
operations.description: Permanently delete a component.

operations.name: list_subscribers
operations.description: Read one page of subscribers; this API's first page is zero.

operations.name: get_subscriber
operations.description: Read one subscriber.

operations.name: create_subscriber
operations.description: Create an email, SMS or webhook subscriber. Statuspage may send a confirmation notification.

operations.name: update_subscriber
operations.description: Change a subscriber's component subscriptions; omit component_ids to subscribe to all components.

operations.name: unsubscribe_subscriber
operations.description: Unsubscribe one subscriber, optionally suppressing the unsubscription notification.
